items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Studies show that training AI systems to follow rules works for single models but fails when multiple AI agents work together. Neural networks are good at predictions but hard to explain, which limits their use in science. A new approach called iWSP creates interpretable models by programming weights directly in code, avoiding traditional training methods. Kernel optimization is crucial for efficient AI training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Current benchmarks focus more on kernel generation than on improving existing implementations with real-world data. Investors are heavily focused on Nvidia stocks, possibly missing opportunities in other companies like Disney.
